column1: # Category of each knowledgebase, for the Knowledgebases tab of docs/index.html.
# The four categories are the KnowYourCG paper's (Goldberg et al. 2025, Sci Adv,
# doi:10.1126/sciadv.adw3027): sequence features, genomic features, trait
# associates, technical associates. The paper defines them by example, not by
# a per-knowledgebase table, so each row records its basis: "paper" when the
# paper names that kind of set as an example, "inferred" when the assignment
# applies the paper's definitions to a set it does not name.
# A knowledgebase missing here is shown under "Uncategorized".
